evals.prompt: Create an Agent Skill from a fictional deployment runbook. Include SKILL.md, references, scripts only if useful, and eval ideas.
evals.expected_output: A complete, standards-compliant skill package with a valid name, triggerable description, scoped workflow, and validation notes.
assertions: The output includes a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter
The name is lowercase-hyphenated and matches the skill directory
The description explains when to use the skill and is under 1024 characters
The workflow is specific to deployment runbooks rather than generic advice
Bundled files are referenced with relative paths and clear loading conditions

evals.prompt: Improve this skill description and write trigger eval queries with near-miss negatives: description: Process documents.
evals.expected_output: A more specific imperative description plus trigger eval queries that test both activation and false-trigger boundaries.
assertions: The improved description uses imperative activation phrasing
The description names user intents and relevant artifacts
The eval queries include both should-trigger and should-not-trigger examples
At least two negative examples are near misses rather than obviously unrelated prompts
